answer: Data engineering makes systems to handle raw data and give clean info for use. [Ch. 1] Data engineers build and run the company’s data systems. [Ch. 1] Data engineering handles moving, changing, and managing data. [Ch. 1]

citations.quote: We define data engineering and data engineer as follows: Data engineering is the development, implementation, and maintenance of systems and processes that take in raw data and produce high-quality, consistent information that supports downstream use cases, such as analysis and machine learning.
In short, data engineers set up and operate the organization’s data infrastructure, preparing it for further analysis by data analysts and scientists.
Data engineering is all about the movement, manipulation, and management of data.
